slow_down: Reduce the speed of your chest compressions.
session_done: Well done. Your practice session is complete.
em_call: Call one one two. Turn on the phone's speaker.
em_hands: Put both hands in the centre of the chest.
em_push: Push the chest hard and fast, in time with the beat.
em_swap: If someone else can push the chest, swap now.
em_aed: If an A E D is nearby, ask someone to bring it.
em_continue: Keep pushing the chest until help arrives.
